Medical visa for patients from Uzbekistan

Uzbek patients travel to Delhi for treatment that is hard to reach at home. TIB HIND issues your invitation letter and our Russian-speaking team guides you through the e-Medical Visa.

Get my visa letter How it works

Free. No obligation. A written opinion within 48 hours.

Who it's for

Who needs this letter

The e-Medical Visa is issued for genuine treatment in India. The invitation letter confirms that a real hospital appointment exists, which is exactly what the visa officer and immigration want to see.

  • You have a diagnosis and a treatment plan for a Delhi NCR hospital
  • The visa officer can confirm the hospital and the treating doctor
  • Immigration sees a letter that matches your visa application
What we need

What you send us

Our Russian-speaking team in Delhi helps you prepare the paperwork and explains each step of the process in your language.

  • Passport copies — valid six months beyond your stay, with blank pages
  • Your medical reports and current diagnosis
  • Proof of funds and your planned travel dates
  • A return ticket once your travel dates are fixed
Steps

The e-Medical Visa steps

Allow roughly a week between applying and travelling. The e-Medical Visa must be applied for at least four days before your flight.

  • Send your reports — your invitation letter is issued within 2–3 working days
  • Apply online for the e-Medical Visa, at least four days before you travel
  • Wait for the approved e-visa — allow about a week
  • Fly to Delhi and carry your invitation letter and medical summary
  • Show your letter at immigration on arrival
Questions

Visa questions

Usually within two weeks of sending your reports: 2–3 working days for the letter, up to a week for the e-visa, then flights. Plan for a week of assessment in Delhi before any procedure.

Yes. The e-Medical Visa allows up to three companions per patient. Your companions apply together with you and carry the same invitation letter.

Send us the refusal notice and we will review it with you in Russian. We correct the invitation or documents if that is the cause and support a fresh application. We will not push you toward a visa that is unlikely to be granted.

We are a facilitator, not a hospital

TIB HIND does not provide medical treatment, diagnosis or emergency care. All treatment is delivered by independent, accredited hospitals and their consultants, who remain solely responsible for clinical decisions.

Costs are ranges, not quotations

Published figures are indicative ranges based on recent cases. Your final cost is set by the treating hospital after clinical assessment and can change if your treatment does.

Your medical records

Reports you send are reviewed by our medical team and are not shared with any hospital without your instruction. See our privacy and data protection policy.

This site is not for emergencies

If you have chest pain, stroke symptoms, severe bleeding or any acute deterioration, contact your local emergency services now. Do not wait for a reply from us.
